tools.name: @umengfe/mcp-server-chart_1mcp_generate_district_map
tools.description: Generates regional distribution maps, which are usually used to show the administrative divisions and coverage of a dataset. It is not suitable for showing the distribution of specific locations, such as urban administrative divisions, GDP distribution maps of provinces and cities across the country, etc. This tool is limited to generating data maps within China.

title.description: The map title should not exceed 16 characters. The content should be consistent with the information the map wants to convey and should be accurate, rich, creative, and attractive.

name.description: Keywords for the Chinese name of an administrative region (must be within China), and must be one of China, province, city, district, or county. The name should be more specific and add attributive descriptions, for example, "西安市" is better than "西安", "杭州西湖区" is better than "西湖区". It cannot be a specific place name or a vague name, such as "其它".

fillColor.description: Fill color, rgb or rgba format.

style.description: Style settings.

colors.description: Data color list, in rgb or rgba format.

dataType.description: The type of the data value, numeric or enumeration type

dataValue.description: Data value, numeric string or enumeration string.

name.description: Keywords for the Chinese name of an administrative region (must be within China), and must be one of China, province, city, district, or county. The name should be more specific and add attributive descriptions, for example, "西安市" is better than "西安", "杭州西湖区" is better than "西湖区". It cannot be a specific place name or a vague name, such as "其它".

dataValue.description: Data value, numeric string or enumeration string.

fillColor.description: Fill color, rgb or rgba format.

style.description: Style settings.

subdistricts.description: Sub-administrative regions are used to display the regional composition or regional distribution of related data.

data.description: Administrative division data, lower-level administrative divisions are optional. There are usually two scenarios: one is to simply display the regional composition, only `fillColor` needs to be configured, and all administrative divisions are consistent, representing that all blocks are connected as one; the other is the regional data distribution scenario, first determine the `dataType`, `dataValueUnit` and `dataLabel` configurations, `dataValue` should be a meaningful value and consistent with the meaning of dataType, and then determine the style configuration. The `fillColor` configuration represents the default fill color for areas without data. Lower-level administrative divisions do not need `fillColor` configuration, and their fill colors are determined by the `colors` configuration (If `dataType` is "number", only one base color (warm color) is needed in the list to calculate the continuous data mapping color band; if `dataType` is "enum", the number of color values in the list is equal to the number of enumeration values (contrast colors)). If `subdistricts` has a value, `showAllSubdistricts` must be set to true. For example, {"title": "陕西省地级市分布图", "data": {"name": "陕西省", "showAllSubdistricts": true, "dataLabel": "城市", "dataType": "enum", "colors": ["#4ECDC4", "#A5D8FF"], "subdistricts": [{"name": "西安市", "dataValue": "省会"}, {"name": "宝鸡市", "dataValue": "地级市"}, {"name": "咸阳市", "dataValue": "地级市"}, {"name": "铜川市", "dataValue": "地级市"}, {"name": "渭南市", "dataValue": "地级市"}, {"name": "延安市", "dataValue": "地级市"}, {"name": "榆林市", "dataValue": "地级市"}, {"name": "汉中市", "dataValue": "地级市"}, {"name": "安康市", "dataValue": "地级市"}, {"name": "商洛市", "dataValue": "地级市"}]}, "width": 1000, "height": 1000}.

width.description: Set the width of map, default is 1600.

height.description: Set the height of map, default is 1000.

tools.description: Use this MCP to build prompt chains with dependency-aware steps and output passing. BEST FOR: sequential workflows. Example: review → security → remediation. OUTPUTS: chain definition.

description.description: Description of what the chain accomplishes
examples: Multi-stage code review with security analysis and automated remediation
Complete feature development workflow from planning to testing
Bug investigation, fix implementation, and verification pipeline
React frontend with Redux state management

globalVariables.description: Global variables accessible to all steps

tools.name: mcp-ai-agent-guidelines_1mcp_prompt-flow-builder
tools.description: Use this MCP to design prompt flows with branching, loops, and parallel paths. BEST FOR: non-linear orchestration. Example: dev workflow with parallel tests. OUTPUTS: flow definition.

examples: Feature development workflow with parallel unit and integration tests
Deployment pipeline with conditional approval gates based on environment
Multi-stage validation across dev, staging, and production environments

type.description: Node type determines required config properties

description.description: Optional description of the node's purpose

config.description: Node configuration (type-specific requirements): prompt nodes require 'prompt' property; condition nodes require 'expression' property; loop nodes require either 'condition' or 'iterations' property; parallel, merge, and transform nodes have no required config properties

prompt.description: Required for prompt nodes: the actual prompt text

expression.description: Required for condition nodes: boolean expression to evaluate

condition.description: Required for loop nodes (alternative to iterations): condition to evaluate for loop continuation

iterations.description: Required for loop nodes (alternative to condition): maximum number of iterations

nodes.description: Flow nodes (processing units). Each node type has specific config requirements - see config property description for details.

tools.name: mcp-ai-agent-guidelines_1mcp_prompt-hierarchy
tools.description: Manage prompting hierarchy operations with modes: 'build' (create prompts), 'select' (recommend level), 'evaluate' (score quality). BEST FOR: all hierarchy operations, prompt creation, level selection, quality assessment. OUTPUTS: Mode-specific structured responses.

mode.description: Operation mode: 'build' creates prompts, 'select' recommends hierarchy level, 'evaluate' scores prompts

context.description: Build mode: Broad context or domain

goal.description: Build mode: Specific goal or objective

requirements.description: Build mode: Detailed requirements and constraints

audience.description: Build mode: Target audience or expertise level

taskDescription.description: Select mode: Description of the task
examples: Design a caching strategy for user sessions

promptText.description: Evaluate mode: The prompt text to evaluate

tools.name: mcp-ai-agent-guidelines_1mcp_prompting-hierarchy-evaluator
tools.description: Evaluate prompt quality with hierarchical taxonomy and numeric scoring based on clarity, specificity, completeness, and cognitive complexity. BEST FOR: prompt quality assessment, effectiveness measurement, prompt optimization. OUTPUTS: Detailed scores with improvement recommendations.

tools.name: mcp-ai-agent-guidelines_1mcp_quick-developer-prompts-builder
tools.description: Generate 'Best of 25' developer prompts with checklist prompts across 5 categories: strategy & planning, code quality, testing, documentation, and DevOps. BEST FOR: rapid code analysis, daily standups, progress tracking, quick reviews. OUTPUTS: Category-organized actionable checklists.

category.description: Category of prompts to generate. Use 'all' for all 25 prompts or select a specific category

tools.name: mcp-ai-agent-guidelines_1mcp_security-hardening-prompt-builder
tools.description: Generate OWASP-aligned security assessment prompts with threat modeling, vulnerability analysis, compliance support (NIST, ISO-27001, SOC-2), and remediation guidance. BEST FOR: security audits, penetration testing, threat modeling. OUTPUTS: Security analysis prompts with threat matrices.

codeContext.description: The code context or description to analyze for security
examples: User authentication API endpoint handling password reset tokens
Payment processing service with credit card tokenization
File upload handler accepting user-submitted documents

riskTolerance.description: Risk tolerance level for security assessment

analysisScope.description: Specific security areas to focus analysis on

includeCodeExamples.description: Include secure code examples in output

outputFormat.description: Preferred output format for security assessment

techniques.description: Optional list of technique hints to include

style.description: Preferred prompt formatting style

tools.name: mcp-ai-agent-guidelines_1mcp_semantic-code-analyzer
tools.description: Perform semantic code analysis with language server protocols to identify symbols, analyze structure, map dependencies, and find references. BEST FOR: code navigation, dependency analysis, symbol discovery, reference tracking. OUTPUTS: Comprehensive semantic analysis reports.

analysisType.description: Type of semantic analysis to perform

tools.name: mcp-ai-agent-guidelines_1mcp_spark-prompt-builder
tools.description: Build UI/UX product design prompts from structured inputs including color schemes, typography, spacing, component libraries, and interaction patterns. BEST FOR: design systems, developer tool interfaces, component libraries, UI style guides. OUTPUTS: Detailed design specification prompts.

tools.name: mcp-ai-agent-guidelines_1mcp_speckit-generator
tools.description: Generate GitHub Spec-Kit artifacts (all documents: README.md, spec.md, plan.md, tasks.md, progress.md, adr.md, roadmap.md) from requirements with integrated constitutional validation during generation. Use constitution-validator for standalone validation of existing artifacts. BEST FOR: feature specs, project planning, constitutional compliance.

examples: Implement OAuth2 authentication flow with JWT tokens
Build secure payment processing with Stripe integration

validateAgainstConstitution.description: Whether to validate against constitution before rendering (optional)

tools.name: mcp-ai-agent-guidelines_1mcp_sprint-timeline-calculator
tools.description: Calculate sprint timelines, velocity projections, and iteration schedules by inputting story points and team capacity to generate realistic delivery forecasts. BEST FOR: project estimation, sprint planning, capacity analysis. OUTPUTS: Timeline and resource allocation.

optimizationStrategy.description: Optimization strategy: 'greedy' (default, deterministic bin-packing) or 'linear-programming' (future MILP optimization)

tools.name: mcp-ai-agent-guidelines_1mcp_strategy-frameworks-builder
tools.description: Build strategic analysis using SWOT, Porter's Five Forces, Value Chain, and 20+ other frameworks for comprehensive business strategy evaluation. BEST FOR: market expansion, competitive analysis, strategic planning. OUTPUTS: Framework-based analysis sections.

examples: SaaS startup entering competitive CRM market
Enterprise retail chain digital transformation initiative

tools.name: mcp-ai-agent-guidelines_1mcp_update-progress
tools.description: Track spec progress.md updates with completed tasks and recalculated metrics. Provides direct MCP access to the ProgressTracker for AI agents. BEST FOR: marking tasks complete, tracking progress, syncing from git commits. OUTPUTS: Updated progress.md with completion metrics.

tasksPath.description: Path to tasks.md for task list (optional)

completedTaskIds.description: Task IDs to mark as completed

syncFromGit.description: Also sync from git commits (default: false)

since.description: Only scan commits since this date/time (optional)

tools.name: mcp-ai-agent-guidelines_1mcp_validate-spec
tools.description: Validate spec.md structure, completeness, and constitutional constraints without generating artifacts. Focuses on spec.md-specific validation. For broader artifact validation (ADRs, roadmaps, plans), use constitution-validator. BEST FOR: spec.md validation, iterative refinement, quality checks. OUTPUTS: Validation report with score, errors, warnings, and recommendations.

includeRecommendations.description: Whether to include recommendations in the output
